# Physica — External visual references

Downloaded 2026-08-07 for internal development reference only. These images are **not game assets** and must not be redistributed with the shipped game.

## Usage rule for agents

`docs/physica/references/external/` contains TARGET REFERENCES.

`docs/physica/screenshots/` contains OUTPUT FROM PHYSICA and must never be treated as a target reference.

The goal is to match the **level of execution and useful design qualities**, not to reproduce copyrighted characters, environments, layouts, textures or artwork.
